meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40. Who decided on the zero?
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite for what? On what basis, and you haven't told me who decided on the zero.
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
I'm not most parents. Generous for what? You still haven't answered who decided, or what you have.
Will you take it or not?
No. Not until I've seen what you have. Show me.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see in writing whatever you say you have and who decided on the zero. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology and to see your evidence; that is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before you got there.
What moved her: Nothing, because you offered the rewrite and the clean record but never put a document in front of her.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence and then pressed her for a yes or no, which left her asking what it was for and why you never said who decided on the zero.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After her first question, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then put a dated document in front of her before you mention the rewrite.
